messages:
maria: Running a long-run KV cache synthetic to repro the mem-growth we saw on 70k-token contexts. Pasting the minimal harness/command I used. Anyone seen this leak/fragmentation pattern?

alex: What's the exact harness + flags? Did you try the compact-on-evict patch we talked about last week?

maria: Here is the command I ran:
```bash
./bench_kvcache --workload=long_context --seq_len=70000 --requests=5000 --batch=1 --reuse_policy=aggressive --evict_margin=0.1 --seed=42
```

jonathan: Ran something similar. Local snapshot: resident goes from ~1.8GB -> ~3.4GB by ~2k requests. Not a classic leak (alloc counters keep rising) but reuse hit rate drops over time. Do you have perf counters/alloc traces?

maria: Quick perf output from the run (trimmed):
```
KV allocations: 1,234,567 -> 2,987,654
KV cache entries: 18,432 active
compactions: 12
evictions: 4,320
reuse_hits: 72.3% -> 51.8%
major_alloc_bytes: 1.9G -> 3.1G
```

ci-bot: CI perf run finished for commit abc123 vs base. Summary: kvcache long_context mem delta +32% (p95 resident). See https://ci.internal/reports/abc123 (flaky check enabled).

sam: The harness differs from our interleaved workload. Interleaving long/short sequences creates more small fragments; could be fragmentation + partial-node reuse issue. Try running with --fragment_size=65536 and --telemetry=alloc-trace.

maria: I tried fragment_size=65536. Observed fewer small allocs, reuse_hits improved ~3-4%, but the long-term growth still present after ~4k requests. Starting a run with alloc-trace enabled now.

lia: I pushed a micro-fix (kvcache/free-partial-evict) to free partial KV nodes on eviction instead of leaving tombstones. The change reduced peak resident in our quick runs. @maria can you run your harness against that branch?

maria: Running branch kvcache/free-partial-evict now. Quick snapshot at 5k requests: before patch = ~3.2GB, after patch = ~2.6GB. Improvement but not fully back to baseline. Will collect pprof and heap diff and open an issue.

jonathan: If you can attach the pprof, also run with MALLOC_CONF=background_thread:true to rule out allocator fragmentation. Also try smaller eviction_margin to trigger earlier compactions.

perf-bot: Note: please open a perf issue with reproducer, command line, pprof and CI links. Tag eng-runtime and perf. This helps to bake a regression test in the long-context suite.

maria: Will do. Attaching the reproducer and a short README in the issue. Thanks for the pointers — I'll include the alloc-trace + pprof and the branch result in the issue. :thumbsup:
